applies_to: AP_INVOICES_ALL, AP_CHECKS_ALL, AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL, AP_EXPENSE_REPORT_HEADERS_ALL, PO_HEADERS_ALL, AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL
description: All _ALL tables must include AND org_id = :p_org_id or MO_GLOBAL filter to prevent cross-org data leakage
PER_PEOPLE_F is a DateTrack table — must filter SYSDATE BETWEEN effective_start_date AND effective_end_date to get current record only
PER_ASSIGNMENTS_F must filter PRIMARY_FLAG='Y' to get the primary assignment only, plus effective date range
AP_INVOICES_ALL should normally exclude cancelled invoices unless the query specifically needs them
AP_CHECKS_ALL should normally exclude void cheques unless specifically needed
GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS should filter summary_flag='N' AND enabled_flag='Y' to exclude summary accounts
AP_EXPENSE_REPORT_HEADERS_ALL SOURCE column must be filtered to include only iExpense records, not all AP expense reports
SELECT * retrieves all columns including BLOBs — breaks if table structure changes and prevents index-only scans
SELECT (SELECT ...) in column list executes once per row — N+1 performance issue on large tables
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE with string concatenation creates SQL injection vulnerability — must use bind variables
LIKE '%value' cannot use a B-Tree index — causes full table scan on potentially millions of rows
NOT IN (SELECT ...) returns zero rows if the subquery contains any NULL — use NOT EXISTS instead
ROWNUM is applied before ORDER BY — results in wrong top-N rows. Use FETCH FIRST or subquery pattern
Prefer FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_VL (language-aware view) over FND_LOOKUPS for multilingual environments. If the base table FND_LOOKUP_VALUES is queried instead, filter language = USERENV('LANG')
In MOAC-enabled environments use MO_GLOBAL.GET_CURRENT_ORG_ID() or MO_GLOBAL.SET_POLICY_CONTEXT to ensure correct ORG_ID rather than hardcoding values
MTL tables use organization_id (not org_id) for inventory organization scoping. Missing this filter returns all organizations data
Must filter by currency_code to avoid summing across currencies in GL balance queries
Filter authorization_status = 'APPROVED' unless reporting all POs including drafts
Use payment_status_flag = 'Y' for fully paid or 'N' for outstanding invoices
Filter status != 'CL' for open items; use gl_date for posted-only AR transactions
Filter period_type and closing_status = 'O' for open periods only
Date comparisons without TRUNC may miss time-component rows — use TRUNC(date_col)
Applying functions to indexed columns (e.g. TO_CHAR(date)) suppresses index use
Tables listed in FROM without JOIN condition produce cartesian product — always check join predicates
Literal values in WHERE clauses prevent cursor sharing — use bind variables :param
EBS FK constraints use RELY DISABLE NOVALIDATE — never add enforced FKs on EBS tables
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE is for debugging only — remove from production PL/SQL packages
